scope: Pre-RR committed diagnostic anchor matches actual native login OID/backend PID/start and is visible through SECDEF without direct table privileges.
Post-cut committed diagnostic authority row is visible to fresh administrator but remains absent inside original RR SECDEF reads.
Original native snapshot text is unchanged; a new transaction sees later row.
Ordinary caller cannot directly select/update anchor or insert authority row.
limits: Fixture writer and SECDEF owner are privileged diagnostic administrator, not admitted native anchor/permit issuer.
No immutable-trigger/DDL/ACL/source closure, action-role/provider custody, one-permit or original seal qualification.
No backend acceptance case promotion; native visibility is only one design prerequisite.
